items.title: A homeomorphism onto a closed subset preserves being nowhere dense
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a homeomorphism of a space onto a closed subset of another space carries nowhere dense subsets to nowhere dense subsets (author lemma at source lines 4278-4284, label lemma-closed-image-nowhere-dense). The proof (source lines 4286-4293) identifies the closure of the image with the image of the closure and transfers emptiness of the relevant interior through the homeomorphism (proof lines 4286-4292). The comparison of closures is the content. H2.
